profile_text.body:
SpaceX, formally SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP, is a public company headquartered at Starbase, Texas, trading under the ticker SPCX. According to its own site, the company designs, manufactures and launches advanced rockets and spacecraft. It was founded in 2002, and the company describes its purpose as revolutionizing space technology with the ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets.

The material available on the company's AI products and position is thin. No products are tracked in the record, and no MCP servers are listed. The site text describes rockets and spacecraft rather than any AI offering.

The record shows no lawsuits involving the company. It does carry a law exposure count of 126 in Texas, the state where it is headquartered. The company also holds SEC registration, with CIK 0001181412.
